issues.description: play.ts changed from public import to internal relative path, breaking sandbox script
issues.detail: play.ts now imports from './packages/zod/src/index.js' instead of 'zod/v4'. This is a developer scratch file and shouldn't be part of the PR — it leaks debug code, may break for users cloning the repo without a build step, and pollutes the diff. Revert before merge.

issues.description: Override count doubled from 6 to 12 with no explanation
issues.detail: to-json-schema.test.ts line 1723 changes the expected overrideCount from 6 to 12. Doubling is a behavior change — overrides now fire for both child and parent in the chain. The test comment 'do not run on references' contradicts this. Either the test name is now wrong, or the behavior change is unintended. Needs explicit justification.

issues.description: Override now always runs even on parent (isParent) schemas
issues.detail: Previously `if (!seen.isParent) ctx.override(...)` skipped parents to avoid running user overrides twice. The new code unconditionally invokes override. This is almost certainly the source of the 6→12 count doubling and is a user-visible regression for anyone relying on override callbacks not firing on parent chain nodes.

issues.description: JSON.stringify deep-equality used in hot dedupe loop is fragile and O(n) per key
issues.detail: Two new loops in flattenRef use `JSON.stringify(schema[key]) === JSON.stringify(refSeen.def![key])`. This is order-sensitive (so `{a,b}` vs `{b,a}` won't dedupe), throws on cycles/BigInt/undefined values, and is quadratic for large nested schemas. Use a structural comparison or skip dedupe for complex values.

issues.description: Non-null assertion on refSeen.def may throw when def is undefined
issues.detail: At line ~407, `key in refSeen.def!` and `refSeen.def![key]` assume def is always present whenever refSchema.$ref is set. If a referenced schema was processed without populating `def` (e.g. processor-only path), this NPEs. Guard with `refSeen.def && ...` like the parent-branch code does at line 430.

issues.description: fileProcessor anyOf branches no longer self-describe; consumers must merge with root
issues.detail: Previously each anyOf branch was a complete StringSchema. Now branches contain only `contentMediaType`, with shared props hoisted to root. While shorter, this changes the public JSON Schema output shape — downstream tools that consumed anyOf branches as standalone schemas will break. Worth a CHANGELOG note at minimum.

review.summary: The core change (tracking parent separately from processor-set ref) is reasonable and the new wrapper-with-id test demonstrates the fix. However, the PR has several concerns: play.ts contains a personal debug scratch that should not ship; the override callback now fires on parent chain nodes (doubling override count from 6→12) which contradicts the existing test's stated intent; the new dedupe logic relies on JSON.stringify equality which is order-sensitive and unsafe for some values; and a non-null assertion on `refSeen.def` could throw. The fileProcessor output shape change is also user-visible.
